source.title: Belfast News-Letter, 6 January 1932, p. 7 ("Belfast nominations: no opposition to seventeen candidates"); Belfast News-Letter, 7 January 1932, p. 7 ("Municipal elections: withdrawals in St. George's and Pottinger wards; 19 unopposed returns")
source.publisher: Belfast News-Letter (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: returned unopposed (News-Letter, 7 January 1932: complete list of unopposed returns)

note: Annual election of one councillor in each of the 15 wards of Belfast Corporation (the member retiring in rotation) together with the triennial election of aldermen for Duncairn, Ormeau, Pottinger, Smithfield, St Anne's, St George's and Woodvale; nominations Tuesday 5 January, poll Friday 15 January 1932. After two withdrawals 19 of the 22 seats were filled unopposed, and Court, Dock and Shankill were contested (Belfast News-Letter, 6, 7 and 16 January 1932). Returned unopposed.
